description: Rechecks an exact product, ZIP, quantity and fulfillment mode and returns a hosted checkout_url. JENNi selects the source internally. The buyer reviews delivery, tax and the total, enters payment details, and places the order on the hosted page. This read-only tool creates no order, reservation or charge.

fulfillment_mode.description: Requested fulfillment mode. Eligibility is checked for the exact product, ZIP and quantity.

product_id.description: The exact item: a variant's product_id when it has variants.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code the order is delivered to, e.g. 78205.

name: start_checkout

unit_price.description: The shelf price the page shows; checkout states the total.

title: Start checkout
